2608.20797.title: Automated Trajectory Evaluation for Mobile Agents via Step-Level Consequence Reasoning and Aggregation
2608.20797.paper_summary: Evaluating language-guided mobile agents has recently shifted from rule-based to model-based approaches to achieve scalable and automated assessments. However, existing holistic evaluation paradigms process entire trajectories at once, leading to substantial context overload. Moreover, they primarily focus on task completion while overlooking operational safety. To address these limitations, we introduce CRATE, a novel two-stage VLM-as-judge framework for automated mobile agent evaluation that is compatible with both open- and closed-source models. Leveraging a step-level consequence reasoning mechanism, CRATE independently extracts task-relevant visual clues and infers action-conditioned state changes at each step. The resulting step-level textual evidence is then synthesized through trajectory-level aggregation to deliver an evidence-grounded evaluation of task completion. Building upon this evaluation scheme, we further extend CRATE to CRATE-S for operational safety assessment. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and robustness of both CRATE and CRATE-S. Powered by Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct, CRATE achieves an F1-score of 0.833 on AndroidWorld (outperforming SPA-Bench by 20%), while CRATE-S reaches an F1-score of 0.697 on MobileRisk, demonstrating strong alignment with benchmark ground truths. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CRATE-D580.
2608.20797.paper_summary_zh: 評估語言導向的移動代理最近已從基於規則的方法轉向基於模型的方法，以實現可擴展和自動化的評估。<lb/>然而，現有的整體評估範式一次處理整個軌跡，導致了相當大的上下文過載。<lb/>此外，它們主要專注於任務完成，而忽視了操作安全。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們引入了CRATE，一種新穎的兩階段VLM作為評判框架，用於自動化移動代理評估，兼容開源和閉源模型。<lb/>CRATE利用步驟級後果推理機制，獨立提取任務相關的視覺線索，並在每一步推斷與行動相關的狀態變化。<lb/>生成的步驟級文本證據然後通過軌跡級聚合進行綜合，以提供基於證據的任務完成評估。<lb/>在此評估方案的基礎上，我們進一步將CRATE擴展為CRATE-S，以進行操作安全評估。<lb/>大量實驗驗證了CRATE和CRATE-S的有效性和穩健性。<lb/>由Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct驅動，CRATE在AndroidWorld上的F1-score達到0.833（比SPA-Bench高出20%），而CRATE-S在MobileRisk上的F1-score達到0.697，顯示出與基準真實值的強一致性。<lb/>代碼可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CRATE-D580獲得。
